setName: 2025 Panini Rookies & Stars Stellar Rookies Signatures
note: R30 (Drew 2026-09-13): a same-numbered autograph subset is its own card set within the product. This is the "Stellar Rookies Signatures" subset of 2025 Panini Rookies & Stars Football, keyed the way productSetKeys.ts forms an insert-set-as-product key. Its colour variants are PARALLELS on this key, not separate keys -- a named parallel is a distinct card, not a distinct set -- so the plain run carries a blank parallel (unknown, never "Base") and each colour carries its own rung. Every row is signed: the section name is the only place this workbook states a signature.
